column1: # tree is KNOWN to fail, and why a commit alone cannot fix them.
# Read by build/lib/pin-coherence-gate.sh (build-image.sh preflight) and by
# build/test-pin-coherence.sh section 3.  Preflight turns a failure of a listed
# rule into a loud WARN naming the owner and the exact fix, and does not abort;
# a failure of any rule NOT listed here aborts the build.  The test suite fails
# when a listed rule starts passing, so a row is deleted in the same commit
# that fixes its rule.  Never add a row to get a build through: an unlisted
# failure is a real pin disagreement.
# Columns (TAB): rule, owner, fix (the exact action that clears it), reason.
